description_en: Adds the EIP or VIP of a zone back to DNS resolution
description_zh: 将可用区对应的EIP/VIP加回到域名解析中
name: CancelShiftLoadBalancerZones

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the client token. The RequestId of each API request is different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。


若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run and does not add the zone back. The system checks whether the required parameters are specified, the request format is valid, and the service limits are met. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.

false (default): performs a dry run and sends the request. If the request passes the dry run, an `HTTP_2xx` status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会加回可用区。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回`HTTP_2xx`状态码并直接进行修改
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the application load balancing instance
parameters.name: load_balancer_id

fields.help_en: The ID of the vSwitch that corresponds to the zone. By default, each zone uses one vSwitch and one subnet
fields.help_zh: 可用区对应的交换机，每个可用区默认使用一台交换机和一个子网
fields.name: vswitch_id

fields.help_en: The ID of the zone. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189196.html operation to query zone IDs
